views.rationale: AMZN's sales growth was driven by increased customer usage, while BAC's revenue growth was primarily due to higher net interest income.
BA's cost of sales decreased 13.9% YoY, while CAT's sales and revenues increased 7% YoY due to higher refined product and crude oil prices.
CVX's earnings increased 6% YoY due to higher margins on refined product sales and the absence of a 2016 asset impairment.
